build_MMFT_model: build a multimodal transformer model using MMFTransformer with text and image modalities
build_encoders: build encoders for each modality by calling build_encoders on the MMFTransformer instance
preprocess_sample: preprocess a sample list into standardized multimodal input tensors via preprocess_sample
tie_weights: tie head weights to encoder token embeddings using the tie_weights method
forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MMFTransformer model with a sample list dictionary
